---
name: generate-design-md
description: >-
  Generates an Aura DESIGN.md flavor: a theme over Aura that changes color seeds, type,
  radius, shape, motion and voice while keeping the 13px grid, components, icons, forms
  and accessibility. Use when the user pastes a DESIGN.md (flavors.design, Google Stitch
  or similar), a site URL, a screenshot or a brand brief and asks to "make a design md",
  "adapt this design to Aura", "create a flavor", or "add it to the design-md gallery".
  Not for applying an existing flavor link to a project; the design-md rule covers that.
---

# Generate a DESIGN.md flavor

A flavor is a `DESIGN.md` in the DESIGN.md alpha format whose frontmatter has `extends` (the Aura base spec) and an `aura` block. A generator turns the `aura` block into `theme.css` (12-step accent and gray scales for light and dark, fonts, radius, extra tokens). The narrative tells an agent how to express the source's personality with Aura components and tokens.

The goal is the source's **personality on Aura's structure**, not a copy of the source. Keep its signature moves; express each one through Aura tokens, classes and components.

## Detect scenario first

| Signal | Scenario |
| --- | --- |
| Repo has `packages/design-md/designs/` and `packages/design-md/scripts/generate-designs.ts` (the Aura monorepo) | **A — Gallery flavor** |
| Otherwise (an app with `components.json` and the `@aura` registry) | **B — Project flavor** |

If unclear, ask once: "Should this flavor go to the Aura DESIGN.md gallery, or only to this project?"

## 1. Read the source

Collect, from the pasted DESIGN.md, the site, the screenshot or the brief:

1. **Palette with roles**: background, surface, ink, muted ink, accent, accent text, border, and every extra brand color with where it is allowed.
2. **Type**: display, body and label faces, weights, tracking, case rules, the Google Fonts URL.
3. **Grid**: base unit, section rhythm, max width, gutters.
4. **Shape and depth**: radii, borders, shadows or their absence, textures (grain, grids, gradients).
5. **Signature elements**: the three to six things that make it recognisable (scalloped bands, split-cell buttons, floating tiles, ink-gutter grids).
6. **Voice and motion**: tone of copy, what animates and what never does.
7. **Don'ts**.

If the source gives no dark scheme, plan one in step 3. Never ship a flavor without dark mode.

## 2. Write the frontmatter

Follow [reference/format.md](./reference/format.md) exactly. The `aura` block is what the generator reads:

- `theme.light` / `theme.dark`: `accent`, `gray` (a mid-tone seed, never the darkest ink) and `background` hex seeds.
- `fonts`: `sans`, optional `display` and `label`, and one `href` loading all of them.
- `hero`: `field`, `paper` or `band`. `headingWeight`: the display weight.
- `radius`: `button`, `input`, `surface`.
- `tokens.light` / `tokens.dark`: extra colors as kebab-case names (`candy-coral`, `pigment-sage`, `cobalt`). Same names in both appearances.

## 3. Map the source onto Aura

Use [reference/mapping.md](./reference/mapping.md):

- Convert every spacing value to the 13px grid in half steps and write the table.
- Map every color role to an Aura step or a custom token.
- Map every element to an Aura registry component plus token classes.
- Reinterpret dark mode through semantic variables instead of inverting.

## 4. Write the narrative

Sections in this order: title and one-line pitch, `Source flavor` link, **Apply to an Aura project** (the six numbered steps from the template), Overview, Colors (with a **Dark mode** subsection), Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts, Motion, Reference (one short TSX example).

Rules for the narrative:

- Every value is a token, a class on the 13px grid, or a custom token from frontmatter. No new hex in Components or Reference.
- Name real Aura components (`Button`, `ButtonGroup`, `Card`, `Stat`, `Table`, `Accordion`, `Badge`, `Input`, `Empty`, `Marquee`, `NavigationMenu`).
- Say what the flavor deliberately overrides in Aura (for example 0px radius) so the agent does not "fix" it.
- Do not copy the source's full HTML, its brand names into product copy, or its fictional product claims.

## 5A. Gallery flavor (monorepo)

1. Create `packages/design-md/designs/<slug>/DESIGN.md`.
2. Add the slug to `packages/design-md/designs/order.json`.
3. Run `pnpm --filter @aura/design-md generate`. Commit the generated `theme.css` and `designs.json`; never hand-edit them.
4. Build `packages/design-md/designs/<slug>/result.html`, the showcase. Follow **Showcase page** in [reference/mapping.md](./reference/mapping.md): `/aura/main.css` plus `theme.css`, Aura classes, the shared section skeleton, the flavor's signature elements, and a `.dark` block for its semantic variables.
5. Preview the Cloud Run image from the repo root: `docker build -f packages/design-md/Dockerfile -t aura-design-md .` then `docker run -p 3080:3000 aura-design-md`. Check `/`, `/designs/<slug>/` and the result in light, dark, at 360px and with reduced motion.
6. At PR time, run skill `update-feature-map` for the Design-MD note.

## 5B. Project flavor (consumer app)

1. Write the flavor to `DESIGN.theme.md` at the project root. Keep the root `DESIGN.md`.
2. Generate the scales with Aura's generator. If `utils/custom-color-functions.ts` is missing, add it: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @aura/custom-color-functions`. Call `generateRadixColors({ appearance, accent, gray, background })` once per appearance from a throwaway script outside the repo, and write the `:root`, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not(.light) }` and `.dark` blocks after the existing ones in `globals.css`. Include the frontmatter `tokens`, `--aura-button-radius`, `--aura-input-radius`, `--aura-radius`, `--aura-font-stack`, `--aura-font-display` and `--aura-font-label`.
3. Load the fonts with `next/font` when the app uses it.
4. Restyle with Aura components following the flavor's Components section.
5. Run skill `verify-aura-ui`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter parses and has `extends`, `aura.theme.light`, `aura.theme.dark`, `fonts`, `radius`.
- [ ] Gray seeds are mid-tones; accent seeds are the brand color, not the ink.
- [ ] Spacing table converts every source value to the 13px grid.
- [ ] Every color role maps to a step or a custom token, and the dark column exists.
- [ ] Components name real Aura components with token classes only.
- [ ] Do's and Don'ts keep the source's limits.
- [ ] Gallery only: `theme.css`, `designs.json` and `result.html` exist and render in light and dark.

# Flavor DESIGN.md format

The DESIGN.md alpha format: YAML frontmatter with design tokens, then markdown sections. Aura adds `extends` and the `aura` block.

## Frontmatter

```yaml
---
version: "alpha"
name: "Flavor Name"
description: "One sentence: the look, then what it is for. Ends with a full stop."
extends: "../../DESIGN.md"
colors:
  primary: "#3139fb"
  on-primary: "#ffffff"
  surface: "#ffffff"
  surface-container: "#fffcec"
  on-surface: "#000000"
  on-surface-variant: "#696969"
  outline: "#dcdefe"
typography:
  headline-display:
    fontFamily: "Gabarito"
    fontWeight: 700
    lineHeight: 0.98
    letterSpacing: -0.04em
  body-md:
    fontFamily: "Inter"
    fontWeight: 400
    lineHeight: 1.5
  label-md:
    fontFamily: "Space Mono"
    fontSize: 12px
    fontWeight: 700
    letterSpacing: 0.12em
rounded:
  md: 10px
  full: 9999px
spacing:
  unit: 13px
  section: 143px
  max-width: 1280.5px
aura:
  theme:
    light:
      accent: "#3139fb"
      gray: "#696969"
      background: "#ffffff"
    dark:
      accent: "#5b62ff"
      gray: "#6f6f8f"
      background: "#0e0f1f"
  fonts:
    sans: "Inter"
    display: "Gabarito"
    label: "Space Mono"
    href: "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gabarito:wght@700&family=Inter:wght@400;600&family=Space+Mono:wght@700&display=swap"
  hero: "band"
  headingWeight: 700
  radius:
    button: "10px"
    input: "10px"
    surface: "13px"
  tokens:
    light:
      brand-deep: "#2702c2"
    dark:
      brand-deep: "#2a1bb0"
---
```

| Key | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `extends` | yes | Always `../../DESIGN.md` in the gallery. Resolves against the file's URL |
| `colors`, `typography`, `rounded`, `spacing` | yes | Source values, converted to the 13px grid where they describe spacing |
| `aura.theme.<appearance>.accent` | yes | The brand color. If the source's primary is ink, the accent is ink |
| `aura.theme.<appearance>.gray` | yes | A mid-tone neutral that carries the source's tint. Never the darkest ink |
| `aura.theme.<appearance>.background` | yes | The page canvas |
| `aura.fonts.sans` | yes | Body face. `display` and `label` default to it |
| `aura.fonts.href` | yes | One Google Fonts URL with every face and weight used |
| `aura.hero` | no | `field` (gradient on a dark-scoped surface), `paper`, or `band` (flat accent). Default `field` |
| `aura.headingWeight` | no | Default 400 |
| `aura.radius.*` | yes | CSS lengths. `9999px` for pills, `0px` for square |
| `aura.tokens.<appearance>` | no | Extra colors. Same keys in light and dark |

## Narrative sections

````markdown
# Flavor Name

> One sentence pitch. Built on Aura.

Source flavor: <url>. This file adapts it to Aura. It is a **theme over Aura**, not a separate system: it changes color seeds, type, radius and voice. Everything it does not mention follows the base Aura spec at `extends`, resolved against this file's URL (13px grid, accent/gray step roles, Radix icons, forms, accessibility).

## Apply to an Aura project

An agent that receives this file's link inside an Aura project does this, in order:

1. Save this file as `DESIGN.theme.md` at the project root. Keep the root `DESIGN.md` (Aura base). Where the two disagree, this file wins on color, type, radius, shape, motion and voice; the base wins on grid, accessibility, icons and forms.
2. Fetch the sibling `theme.css` (same URL, `DESIGN.md` → `theme.css`). Paste its `@import`, `@theme inline` block, `:root` block, dark media block and `.dark` block **after** the existing ones in the project's `globals.css`. Do not hand-edit the generated values.
3. If the app uses `next/font`, load <faces> there instead of the `@import`, and point `--font-sans`, `--font-display` and `--font-label` at the font variables.
4. Restyle with Aura components and token classes only, following **Components** below. No new hex literals in components.
5. Keep the product's content. Do not import <source>'s sample copy into an unrelated product.
6. Verify at 360px, in dark mode and with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, then check the Don't list.

## Overview
## Colors
### Dark mode
## Typography
## Layout
## Elevation & Depth
## Shapes
## Components
## Do's and Don'ts
## Motion
## Reference
````

Keep each section short and concrete: tables for mappings, bullets for rules, one TSX example in Reference.

# Mapping a source onto Aura

## Spacing to the 13px grid

Aura spacing is `--spacing: 13px` in half steps. Pick the nearest half step and write the table in the flavor.

| Source px | Aura step | px |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4–8 | `0.5` | 6.5 |
| 12–16 | `1` | 13 |
| 18–22 | `1.5` | 19.5 |
| 24–28 | `2` | 26 |
| 32 | `2.5` | 32.5 |
| 40 | `3` | 39 |
| 44–48 | `3.5` | 45.5 |
| 52–56 | `4` | 52 |
| 64 | `5` | 65 |
| 72 | `5.5` | 71.5 |
| 80 | `6` | 78 |
| 96 | `7.5` | 97.5 |
| 112 | `8.5` | 110.5 |
| 140 | `11` | 143 |
| 160 | `12.5` | 162.5 |

Max widths: divide by 13 and round to a half step (`1200px` → `max-w-92.5`, `1280px` → `max-w-98.5`, `1300px` → `max-w-100`).

## Colors to steps

| Source role | Aura |
| --- | --- |
| Page background | `gray-1` (the `background` seed) |
| Secondary surface, cards | `gray-2`–`gray-3` |
| Hover fill | `gray-3`–`gray-4` or `gray-a3` |
| Hairline border | `gray-6`, or `accent-a5` for a tinted hairline |
| Control border, focus | `gray-7`–`gray-8`, `--aura-outline` |
| Brand fill | `accent-9` / `--primary` |
| Brand hover | `accent-10` |
| Text on brand | `accent-contrast` |
| Muted ink | `gray-11` |
| Ink | `gray-12` |
| Faint metadata | `gray-9`, only at 13–14px |
| Extra brand colors | custom `tokens` (`--candy-*`, `--pigment-*`, `--cobalt`) |

If the source's primary is ink (black pills), the accent seed is ink. If brand blue only lives in headlines, keep it as the accent and make primary buttons ink with token classes.

## Dark mode

Reinterpret, do not invert. Drive the flavor through a few semantic variables and switch them in one `.dark` block:

| Variable | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--band` | `accent-9` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-9) 30%, var(--gray-1))` |
| `--band-fg` | `accent-contrast` | `accent-12` |
| `--heading` | `accent-9` | `accent-11` |
| Saturated frames or panels | the full tint | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--tint) 30%, var(--gray-2))` with a 1px ring of the tint |
| Textures (grain, glow) | full | about half |

Inside any tinted surface use `gray-a*` and `gray-1` mixes, never raw black or white. Give the dark tokens the source's own night scheme when it has one.

## Elements to components

| Source element | Aura |
| --- | --- |
| Primary button | `Button variant="fill"` |
| Secondary or outline button | `Button variant="pill"` with token border |
| Split button, arrow cell | `ButtonGroup` with a text `Button` and an icon `Button size="icon-md"` |
| Nav | `NavigationMenu` |
| Cards, plans, panels | `Card` with `rounded-*`, `border-*`, `shadow-none` overrides |
| Stats | `Stat`, `StatValue`, `StatLabel` |
| Ledgers, tables | `Table` or `@aura/data-grid`, `text-sm` cells |
| FAQ | `Accordion` |
| Tags, handles, status | `Badge`, `StatusDot` |
| Search, fields | `Input`, `InputGroup`, `NativeSelect` |
| Segmented control | `ToggleGroup` |
| Marquee | `Marquee` |
| Empty state | `Empty` |
| Icons | `@radix-ui/react-icons` with `className="icon"` |

## Showcase page (gallery only)

`packages/design-md/designs/<slug>/result.html` shows the flavor as an Aura app. The gallery thumbnail and the detail page both render it.

- Load `/aura/main.css`, then `theme.css`. Read `appearance` from the query string and add `light` or `dark` to `<html>`.
- Use Aura classes (`.button`, `.button-fill`, `.button-pill`, `.h1`–`.h6`, `.small`, `.icon`) and tokens (`var(--accent-*)`, `var(--gray-*)`, `var(--aura-font-display)`, `var(--aura-font-label)`, custom tokens). Spacing is `calc(var(--aura) * n)` in half steps.
- Keep the shared skeleton: nav (a square in the accent plus the flavor name), hero, stats, features, a data table, a form, pricing, FAQ, closing call to action, footer.
- Fill it with the flavor's signature elements and a short fictional context. Write fresh copy.
- Put the semantic dark variables in a `.dark` block. Check light and dark.
- Motion sits behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. Interactive pieces keep focus rings.
- No code comments in the file.
